message: This is a protocol test. Step 1: call submit_report with status "done", summary "first try", and files set to the plain string array ["calc.py"] exactly (strings, not objects). Step 2: if the tool returns an error, read the error and call submit_report again with corrected arguments. Do not use any other tool.
